title: Issue page type scale and section headings

after.caption: Title only: 24/600/32, letter-spacing -0.16px, key line 13px sans. Body stays 13/19.5.
Title 24/600/32, body 14/22, column 40rem, section headings 13/600 ink sentence case, 1px rule above Links/Worklogs/Activity/Attachments, 32px gaps.
Full Linear scale: body 15/24 weight 450, section headings 15/600, same rules and gaps.

notes: Shown on PSAPAC-1 (rich description, links, comments) at 1440x900 dark. Property group headings (h3 in the sidebar) intentionally left 11px uppercase. Option C heading size is 15 per V2 option B. Description/section headings were shared between V1 and V2, so one set of images covers both.

title: Button chrome: section plus buttons and ghost row actions

after.caption: Add link/worklog/attach become a 24px "+" at the section heading; Remove becomes a ghost x; comment Edit/Delete are ghost 12px text revealed on hover (first comment hovered), Delete turns red only on hover; link rows lose their box (36px); Clear removed; Comment 28px.

domTweaks: data-force attribute on the first Links li so its ghost x shows while the mouse hovers a comment (stands in for :hover); before shot has the same hover.
notes: Before shot taken scrolled 250px with the first comment hovered. Edit description is shown as a ghost button. Three-tier system: primary accent fill, secondary outlined 28px (not shown on this page), ghost 24px.

title: Tree rows: heights and row anatomy

after.caption: Rows 32px, group headers 36px with an 8px gap above (recommended).
Rows 36px, headers 36px.
Rows 44px (Linear): about 17 rows per screen instead of 24.
Option A heights plus title weight 500, key in sans 12/450 tabular-nums (min 5.5rem), type word removed.

domTweaks: relayout(): rewrites each treeitem inline top/height (rows are absolutely positioned) with rowH/headH/gap: A {32,36,8}, B {36,36,0}, C {44,44,0}; customer header = level-1 row with a direct .font-semibold span. Undone via window.__undo.
notes: Priority glyph and Updated date from V5 were not prototyped (no data wired to the Tree row; would need a source change). The spec width w-[5.5rem] min-w-fit is approximated with min-width:5.5rem; width:auto. Tree blurred so no focus ring shows.

Light: same, with --status-doing darkened to oklch(0.58 0.15 75) (4.19:1).

domTweaks: glyphs(): every StatusDot svg gets a half-pie path (In Progress) or a canvas-coloured check path (Done), chosen by stroke colour.
notes: Hide done toggled off so Done rows show. Option B (chroma 0.06) not shown.

title: Focus and selection

after.caption: Focused row PSAPAC-3: soft fill + 1px edge. Peek-selected row PSAPAC-4: --selected fill, 1px edge and 2px accent left bar. Rows inset 8px with 8px radius; accent ring only on the Tree container; sidebar Issues gets the same 2px bar.
Same in light. Light values were chosen by me (focus fill oklch(0.94 0.012 275), edge oklch(0.84 0.03 275); selected edge oklch(0.8 0.06 275)); the finding only gave dark values.

domTweaks: data-active moved from PSAPAC-4 to PSAPAC-3 on the DOM so focus and Peek-selected show on different rows with the Tree focused (before and after both use this).
notes: Header rows (customer bands) are also inset 8px/8px radius per the finding.

title: Properties sidebar, Peek

after.caption: Uniform 32px rows, editable rows grouped first with an 8px gap before read-only rows, 1px rule under the title block, 12px chevrons, muted None, values 13/500, S/A/P/L keycap on the hovered row (Priority forced to show it).

domTweaks: tweak(): muted-None colouring, kbd.kh keycaps appended to the S/A/P/L buttons, data-force on the Priority button to stand in for hover. Reordering is done in CSS (flex order on the dl).
notes: Clip is the Peek aside (416px). Keycap letters come from aria-keyshortcuts. Type/Customer/Engagement/Updated stay read-only without hover pill (editable vs read-only now differs by chevron). I did not add per-property 16px icons (no icon set agreed); chevrons carry the affordance.

title: Properties sidebar, issue page

after.caption: Same rules on the page sidebar plus: Set start date / Set due date / Set estimate as muted actions with 16px icons (native date widget replaced by text input), Time left hidden until an estimate exists, text fields get a 3:1 --field-border (dark oklch(0.52 0.012 275), light oklch(0.64 0.012 275)).

domTweaks: Same tweak(); additionally type=text on the empty date inputs, placeholder text swaps, Time left row display:none.
notes: Clip is the 336px properties aside. Date inputs lose their native picker in this mock; the real change would show formatted text and open a popover on focus.

title: Create dialog

after.caption: Symmetric 20px padding on the field block, labels align with the title, "Required" on Engagement and in the Summary placeholder.
Chip strip: nine rows become two wrapped lines of pill chips (label + value); required Customer/Engagement are accent-tinted filled chips, Engagement carries "Required".

domTweaks: reqTweak(): appends a Required span to the Engagement button and changes the Summary placeholder. chipTweak(): data-req on Customer/Engagement chips plus the same Required span.
notes: Dialog opened from the Beta Ltd header so Customer is prefilled. Option B lost roughly 190px as the finding predicts but chip labels and values are visually tight; the picker chevrons are gone in this mock (a real chip would need them). Clipped to the dialog plus 24px.

title: Toast, success

after.caption: The real "priority changed" toast restyled: one 40px row, auto width (max 28rem), 16px icon, 13px/500 message, ghost Undo, 24px close, anchored left:248px bottom:16px at the Tree edge. Notes are hidden in the compact state.

notes: Anchored left:248px (sidebar 232 + 16). The Peek was closed with Esc, so it sits over the Tree only. Not shown: stacking the last two toasts, and the undo/created variants (created uses the check icon, "Undid" would use an undo glyph).

title: Toast, refused edit

after.caption: Refusal reported as a sticky alert toast: warning icon in --danger, "Priority not changed", Jira reason on one muted line, Retry and close. The inline paragraph under the Peek is hidden and the reverted Priority row is flashed.

domTweaks: refTweak(): the toast element is injected by hand (the app shows no toast for a refused property edit today), plus data-flash on the Priority button.
notes: The reason copy "not allowed for this issue type" is illustrative; the fake answers with a generic 400. Real implementation sends the refusal through the existing Toast with warned: true. The 1s flash is shown as a still highlight.

title: Narrow layout at 1024x700

after.caption: Sidebar collapsed to a 48px icon rail; the Peek is a 360px floating card (right 8px, 12px radius, 0 4px 40px shadow) over the Tree; the Tree gets the full width so titles and the toolbar fit on one row.

domTweaks: narrowTweak(): builds the rail (monogram, Issues, New view, theme icons) inside the nav; the real nav content is hidden with CSS.
notes: Options B (always overlay) and C (320px column) not rendered. The card sits on top of the rightmost columns of the Tree (the Epic/Story word and avatars) because the Tree is not shrunk; a scrim or right padding on the Tree would be a decision for the implementer. A720 drawer/scrim from the a11y finding is not shown.

domTweaks: data-pending attribute on the Priority button; write held by the fake (releaseEdit never called).
notes: Spinner is a CSS border animation, a still frame here.

title: Empty state

after.caption: Icon, 15/600 title naming the real causes (text "zzzzqq" and Type: Bug), toggles on a muted second line, one primary Clear filters button; the chip-row "Clear" link is hidden.
